headline: Restoring oriented Pauli labels splits the 2160 projective decorated hinges into two 8640-element Sp(4,3) orbits when the two outer Wilson/tori are ordered, distinguished by signed symplectic product 1 versus 2. The split is exchanged by swapping the outer tori. Restoring heterotic lattice data also distinguishes the frozen SU(5) and SO(10) witnesses even though bare W33 points are transitive.

oriented_hinges.unlabeled_outer_pair: one orbit after allowing the outer-line swap

phase_boundary: The zeta_12 exponents in the explicit E8-to-Pauli lift are basis/cocycle-gauge data. That certificate explicitly permits cocycle gauges and homogeneous rescalings, so raw exponents are not canonical orbit invariants without transporting the full lifted Clifford action.
correlation_boundary: The two frozen GUT witnesses occupy different enriched lattice fingerprints, but two examples do not establish a statistical selector; their coarse fingerprints each contain thousands of modular-compatible Wilson classes.
